text:
Clara (Acme): Hey team — our org dashboard shows $500 trial credits, but API usage (service key) is being billed normally. Console: credits present. API: charges appear on invoices. Project: proj-87, org: org-zu12. We tried generating and embedding, both show usage billed. Any idea?

Mia (Support): Sorry for the trouble — can you paste the org_id, project_id, and last 4 chars of the service key? Also which endpoint is showing billed usage (generation vs embeddings)?

Clara (Acme): org-zu12, proj-87, key last4: 1a2b. Both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings show billed tokens. Example curl we ran: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx1a2b" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2","input":"ping"}'
```
Response body is successful but billing shows token consumption and no credit deduction.

Mia (Support): Thanks. I'm opening an internal billing ticket and pinging billing. Meanwhile can you confirm whether the credits were applied at the org level or a billing_account? (sometimes promo+org mapping delays)

Clara (Acme): Credits were granted by the sales rep yesterday and I see them in the org billing page (UI shows $500 trial). We didn't touch billing_account mapping.

Sam (DevEx): Quick guess — entitlement propagation sometimes lags: promo was attached to the org record but the per-project entitlement cache didn't update. If the credits aren't linked to the project's billing_account_id, meter runs won't apply them to service keys.

Erin (SRE): Can you check the billing sync job logs? I saw a transient error earlier where the credits-sync queue timed out and left some orgs unpropagated. Sample log snippet: 
```
INFO credits-sync JobRunner: processing org org-zu12
ERROR credits-sync CacheWriter: write timeout -> marking org as pending
```
If that's the case, a re-sync should fix it.

Mia (Support): Filed INC-2026-135 and assigned to @Juan (billing). Adding Clara's org/project/key details. SLA P2.

billing-bot: Ticket INC-2026-135 created and assigned to billing.team — priority: P2 — owners: juan.r, billing-ops.

Juan (Billing): Looking. I see the promo row for org-zu12 but the billing_account_id was null for proj-87 due to a migration hiccup. The credits were queued but resync was stuck because of an index error on credits_queue table. I'm running a manual reprocess now.

Juan (Billing): Reprocess kicked off. Expect credits to be applied on next metering pass (hourly runs). I'll also run a retroactive adjustment if metering already recorded charges. ETA ~30-45m.

Sam (DevEx): For future quick checks, you can run the internal endpoint (admin-only) to check entitlement mapping: GET /internal/billing/org/org-zu12/entitlements — will show linked projects and credit rows.

Erin (SRE): The queue problem was from an aborted migration; I've patched the index and cleared the backlog. Credits reprocessing is green. :white_check_mark:

Mia (Support): Clara — billing team reprocessed the credits and SRE cleared the queue. They said the next hourly metering run will apply the credits and any charges will be adjusted retroactively. I'll keep this thread updated.

Clara (Acme): Thanks — I'll watch. Do you need any logs from our side?

Juan (Billing): Not needed now, we have the org/proj/key info. We'll post when it's reflected.

billing-bot: Metering run started for hour 2026-03-17T18:00Z.

billing-bot: Metering run completed for hour 2026-03-17T18:00Z — credits applied to org-zu12, projects updated.

Clara (Acme): Confirmed — API now shows usage with credits deducted and invoice adjusted. Balance dropped as expected. Thank you! :pray:

Mia (Support): Great — closing INC-2026-135. Please reopen if anything else pops up.

Clara (Acme): All good. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Juan (Billing): Root cause note: migration left orphaned project mapping for some orgs. Added a post-migrate validator to avoid recurrence.

Sam (DevEx): Filed follow-up doc in docs/internal/billing-migrations with detection queries.

Mia (Support): Marking resolved. :tada:
